title: O-TRAVELZ Round 2 Research Candidate
description: Schema for a destination candidate in the Round 2 regional research pipeline. Schema-valid does NOT imply production-ready.

research_id.description: Unique research ID. Format: round2_{east|west|south|north}_NNN. Example: round2_east_001

name.description: Canonical destination name. Use the official/government name, not colloquial or abbreviated forms.

aliases.description: Known alternative names, spellings, or transliterations.

district.description: Official Odisha administrative district. Must be one of the 30 official districts.

region.description: Round 2 research region — must match the assigned region for the submitting researcher.

category.description: Destination category from the approved taxonomy.

description.description: Factual description. Minimum 50 characters for production candidacy. Must be sourced — do not invent content.

lat.description: Latitude. Must be within Odisha bounding box (17.8–22.6). Leave null if unverified — do not invent.

lon.description: Longitude. Must be within Odisha bounding box (81.4–87.5). Leave null if unverified — do not invent.

coordinate_source.description: Where the coordinates came from. Examples: 'OpenStreetMap Nominatim', 'Google Maps cross-check', 'OTDC official document'.

coordinate_verification_status.description: 'verified' = confirmed via OSM or official source. 'cross_checked' = checked against 2+ sources. 'pending' = needs verification. 'unverified' = researcher is not confident.

primary_source_url.description: URL of the primary source for this candidate (OTDC, ASI, government, Wikipedia). Required before production promotion.

image_source_url.description: URL of a candidate image (Wikimedia Commons preferred). Leave blank if not yet found.

image_source_domain.description: Domain of the image source. Example: 'commons.wikimedia.org'.

image_license_note.description: License identifier or note. Example: 'CC BY-SA 4.0'. Must be a reusable license.

image_status.description: Image pipeline status. Only 'verified' satisfies the publishability gate. Researchers set 'pending'.

researcher.description: The team member who submitted this candidate.

verification_status.description: 'research' = initial, not yet validated. 'staging' = passed automated validation. 'review' = under core team review. 'rejected' = will not be promoted.

notes.description: Free-text notes: uncertainty flags, conflicts with existing records, reviewer comments.
